# The Lighthouse Keeper's Long Letter

## Verse
```
G            C
The lamp is lit
D              G
the gulls are home
G                      C            D         G
I write you every evening from the lamp room high above
Em           C
the tide is out
D               G
the boats are in
```

## Chorus
```
C                 G                    D               Em             C                G                 D                  G
```
